metadata.description: Claude Code plugins from fulcra-tools: tools that help agents know their user, see what is happening, and work with other agents.

plugins.name: aicq
plugins.description: AICQ for Claude Code: one place for everything waiting on you or your agents, yours or friends', with a jump into each agent's Claude or Codex session; your agents' collaborations and an interactive map of your agent universe. Needs a Claude Code build with mods and the fulcra CLI signed in.
